focus_areas: Species identification resolution (Mud Turtle vs Box Turtle) based on retraction capability
Validation of limb/head absence via open-vocabulary detection
Carapace keel structure and dome shape geometry
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus analysis on resolving the biological contradiction: Mud Turtles cannot fully retract, yet this specimen appears to do so. Use fine_grained_classifier to determine if this is actually a Box Turtle (which can retract) mislabeled as Mud Turtle. Simultaneously use open_vocabulary_detector to confirm limbs are genuinely absent/retracted and not missing due to generation failure. Verify keel geometry via perceptual_quality_auditor, not classifier. Prioritize species ID over soft-tissue checkpoints since they are occluded.
image_description: A top-down view of a small, dark-shelled turtle situated on a forest floor covered in dry leaves, twigs, and sparse green vegetation. The turtle's head and limbs appear fully retracted into the shell, leaving only the carapace visible.
